images.description: Modern glass office building for trust and corporate authority on the landing page.
Blue line chart on grid representing algo trading patterns for marketing sections.
Professional team representing Kanak Infosys management.

pages_instructions.landing_page: High-contrast design. Stark white background. Hero section with image overlay (max 30% black if text is light, or minimal white overlay if text is dark). Large 'Cabinet Grotesk' typography. Clear call to action for Login/Register.
pages_instructions.login_register: Clean, distraction-free form. Input fields for Name, Email, Referral Code. Minimalist, brutalist borders.
pages_instructions.client_dashboard: Modular UI. 'North Star' single-metric focus: Deposit Balance and Daily Earnings prominently displayed. Use 'Control Room' grid. Flat cards with 1px borders. Use monospace font for INR values (e.g., ₹1,00,000). Show referral code in a copyable field.
pages_instructions.client_profile: Form-centric. 2-line address, bank details inputs. Clear deposit CTA. Ensure forms are accessible.
pages_instructions.company_policy: Editorial layout. Generous reading width (max-w-prose). High contrast text for terms (6-month lock-in, min deposit 1 lakh INR).
pages_instructions.admin_dashboard: Data-heavy but calm. Recharts for daily revenue line chart. High-level metric cards for total revenue and payouts.
pages_instructions.admin_clients_list: Data table utilizing Shadcn UI. Features 'Export to Excel' button. Clear alignment for financial numbers (right-aligned).
pages_instructions.admin_referral_tree: Visual hierarchy. Use nested lists or organizational chart structure to display parent-child referral relationships. Card-based nodes.

specific_requirements.currency_formatting: Always format numbers in INR (₹) using Indian numbering system (e.g., ₹1,00,000 for 1 lakh, ₹1,00,00,000 for 1 crore).
specific_requirements.data_testid: Apply data-testid to all interactive and key elements using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., login-submit-button, deposit-amount-input).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you output only JavaScript (.js/.jsx) files and not TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) files for the frontend implementation. Use standard Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them via Tailwind classes provided in these guidelines. Apply data-testid to all interactive elements.
